purpose: Evidence-based priors for future Forex Factory predictions. Never rewrite historical predictions.

guardrails.rule: Only ACTIONABLE segments may materially change future confidence. EARLY_SIGNAL is advisory only; INSUFFICIENT causes no change.
guardrails.anti_overfit: Use learned evidence as one input, not as a deterministic direction override. New macro facts and market context remain primary.
guardrails.anti_leakage: Market context and evaluation anchors use only information available at or before the prediction decision time.
